test_network_status.title: Verify network status displays correct configuration

steps.expected: The NETWORK STATUS page is shown.
A MAC address is shown, the IP address is the camera's IP, the subnet mask is 255.255.255.0 and a default gateway on the lab network (192.168.x.x) is shown.
HTTP 80, HTTPS 443 and RTSP 554 are listed.

test_rtsp_stream_configuration.title: Verify RTSP stream is accessible and configured correctly

steps.expected: The RTSP INFORMATION page is shown.
It is rtsp://<camera IP>:554/<channel> (channel1, or the lens's channel on a multi-lens camera), and the Identifier field shows the same channel.
Audio and Meta options are present, and a Copy button is beside the URI.
